items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: And that's where Bunk, Dineswil, Paul Wilde, David Luggan.

ctx.x: Uh, Bunk and they were playing in a place, what town was that I got lost? Yeah, it was the only town across the Bayer. Why'd they call it that? Across the Bayer or something? It was across. Bayer Rapide. Right across on the other side.
Uh huh. Like a little island over there. Uh huh. Nothing but fast. Help people. I got the picture. Of it now. And that's where Bunk, Dineswil, Paul Wilde, David Luggan.
That's where they was, that's where they was working at.
